zones.label: Structured data (JSON-LD)
zones.text:
What is an applied AI company?
An applied AI company helps businesses use AI in real production workflows rather than limiting it to demos or experiments. For software teams, that means using AI inside the engineering process and measuring whether it improves delivery.
What are applied AI services?
Applied AI services help companies move AI from experimentation into production. GoGloby combines the AI Intelligence Layer, Forward-Deployed Engineers who install the Agentic SDLC, and AI spend optimization so teams can improve delivery and measure the result.
How is GoGloby different from an AI consulting firm?
GoGloby delivers and measures inside your workflow, where a consulting firm advises and leaves. We benchmark your AI spend, forward-deploy engineers into your pipeline, and prove the return every month against your baseline, all in one contract.
How does the AI Intelligence Layer measure AI ROI?
The AI Intelligence Layer connects AI spending with engineering work. It shows what work costs, where AI is being used, and how those numbers change against the team's baseline.
Who is GoGloby for?
GoGloby is for established B2B software companies, usually a CTO or VP of Engineering with a 20+ engineering org and an AI budget already spent. The highest-priority fit is PE-backed, with board pressure to prove AI ROI in measurable numbers.
Do we need to replace our current tools?
No. The AI Intelligence Layer connects with tools the team already uses, such as Jira, GitHub, Claude Code, and Cursor. GoGloby engineers also work through the client's existing development workflow.

zones.label: Company: The Applied AI Engineering Gaps We Solve
zones.text:
The Applied AI Engineering Gaps We Solve
Five problems often appear when established software companies start using AI. The first step is identifying which one is actually limiting the result.
Uneven AI Adoption
Some engineers use AI throughout their workflow while others barely use the tools they have. Buying licenses does not guarantee adoption. The AI Intelligence Layer shows where AI is actually being used and where adoption is still limited.
Unstable AI Delivery
AI can help engineers write code faster without helping the team ship faster. More changes enter review, reviewers become the bottleneck, and no one knows whether AI-generated output is safe to merge. The goal is to improve the whole workflow, not just code generation.
Uncontrolled AI Spend
AI spending can grow quickly across Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and model usage. The problem is knowing which spending contributes to shipped work and which spending produces little value.
Invisible AI ROI
Companies spend more on AI, but many still cannot show what changed in delivery. GoGloby connects AI ROI to shipped work and makes it visible per feature, per team, per developer, and per dollar against the company’s starting baseline.
No Number For The Board
Everyone works with AI, budgets are approved, and when the board asks what it returned there is nothing to show. Hours and story points say nothing about AI. The Layer gives the CTO one chart against the company’s own baseline.
No Access to Proven AI Talent
Engineers who already run an agentic SDLC on production code are a few thousand people, and labs and hyperscalers compete for every one. They’re not on job boards, and a mid-market offer rarely wins. GoGloby embeds them nearshore, forward-deployed in under 4 weeks.

zones.label: How it works: How Our Applied AI Engineering Model Works
zones.text:
How Our Applied AI Engineering Model Works
Start by measuring the current engineering workflow. Then improve the areas holding AI-assisted delivery back and compare each result with the baseline.
1
Week 1: See Your Numbers
Connect the existing engineering tools and establish the starting point. See what shipped work costs, where AI is actually being used, and where work slows down in the delivery process.
2
Month 1+: Forward-Deployed Engineers Ship With You
GoGloby engineers work inside the existing development process and establish one way of working with AI instead of ten private workflows. They improve how AI-assisted work moves from coding through review and production, with every change measured against the baseline established at the start.
3
Every Month After: ROI Grows
Compare delivery and AI spending with the previous baseline: more work shipped per dollar, faster delivery per task, and waste cut before it is spent. One chart gives the CTO, engineering team, and board the same view of what improved and what should change next.
4
Need the AI leader first, or alongside?
AI Leadership Search runs in parallel. Brief in week 1, pre-vetted shortlist while the engineers are embedding, and the hire steps into a team that’s already measured.

zones.text:
FAQs
What is an applied AI company?
An applied AI company helps businesses use AI in real production workflows rather than limiting it to demos or experiments. For software teams, that means using AI inside the engineering process and measuring whether it improves delivery.
What are applied AI services?
Applied AI services help companies move AI from experimentation into production. GoGloby combines the AI Intelligence Layer, Forward-Deployed Engineers who install the Agentic SDLC, and AI spend optimization so teams can improve delivery and measure the result.
How is GoGloby different from an AI consulting firm?
GoGloby delivers and measures inside your workflow, where a consulting firm advises and leaves. We benchmark your AI spend, forward-deploy engineers into your pipeline, and prove the return every month against your baseline, all in one contract.
How does the AI Intelligence Layer measure AI ROI?
The AI Intelligence Layer connects AI spending with engineering work. It shows what work costs, where AI is being used, and how those numbers change against the team’s baseline.
Who is GoGloby for?
GoGloby is for established B2B software companies, usually a CTO or VP of Engineering with a 20+ engineering org and an AI budget already spent. The highest-priority fit is PE-backed, with board pressure to prove AI ROI in measurable numbers.
Do we need to replace our current tools?
No. The AI Intelligence Layer connects with tools the team already uses, such as Jira, GitHub, Claude Code, and Cursor. GoGloby engineers also work through the client’s existing development workflow.
